Subject: Next steps + 30-min demo — please pick a slot

Hi Alex & Priya,

Really enjoyed the conversation earlier — thanks for walking us through the ingestion flow and the latency targets you’re optimizing for. Quick recap:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for on-demand summaries across clinician workflows (target median < 150ms for 512-token responses).
- Data constraints: all PHI must stay within your VPC and we need auditability for token retention.
- Success criteria for pilot: 1) sub-200ms median, 2) cost per 1k tokens < $X (TBD), 3) basic integration with your event webhook.

To keep momentum, would you pick one of these 30-minute time slots for a short product walkthrough (we’ll demo the runtime, batching behavior, and a quick integration pattern):
1) Wed, Jun 24 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT / 1:00–1:30 PM ET
2) Thu, Jun 25 — 8:30–9:00 AM PT / 11:30–12:00 PM ET
3) Fri, Jun 26 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT / 5:00–5:30 PM ET

Please let us know who from your side should join (technical lead + one product person is ideal). I attached a short draft agenda and a brief pilot checklist so you can see the scope.

Attachments: [attachment: agenda-draft.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)]

If you prefer, here’s a one-click scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo

Thanks — happy to shift around if these don’t work.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
